2x2 real-rotation unitarity Gram core: M=[[c,-s],[s,c]], M*M=diag(c^2+s^2); unitary iff c^2+s^2=1. Verified realOrthogonalRotation L23-29 + realOrthogonalRotation_unitary L32-57 (Fin.sum_univ_two, off-diagonals cancel by ring). Conjugation trivial on reals -> correctly stated. Decl unique to batch2. Exact iff, not approx.

Unitary-vs-cleanentry asymmetry core IS source-faithful and distinct: amplitudeRotation_unitary unconditional (L93-96 via realRotation_unitary), amplitudeRotation_cleanEntry needs BOTH -1<=x (lower) and x<=1 (upper) (L99-102 via Real.cos_arccos). formal field is null (no formal-status leak in current artifact). REJECT on a factual error in reference_answer prose: it asserts Mathlib arccos is 'pinned to 0 outside [-1,1]' -- false, Real.arccos clamps to pi for x<-1 (0 only for x>1). The answer then self-contradicts ('clamped ... to 0 or pi ... (1 or -1)'). The load-bearing exact-vs-approx boundary (-1<=x<=1) is correct, but the arccos-clamp justification is wrong; author must fix the prose. Core itself clean and acceptable once corrected.

Block-diagonal unitarity core: star commutes with blockDiagonal, product collapses blockwise to I. Verified blockDiagonal_unitary L122-145 (star_blockDiagonal entrywise + blockDiagonal_mul + pointwise star B_k*B_k=1). Over C, no cross-block interaction needed. Decl unique to batch2. Distinct from be-105 (single 2x2) and be-109 (Kronecker).

Reindex-unitarity core: reindexAlgEquiv by one equiv on both axes preserves unitarity; star commutes with reindex, reindex multiplicative. Verified reindex_unitary L105-119 (star_reindex rfl + reindexAlgEquiv_mul). Same-equiv-both-axes essentiality is exactly the multiplicativity invoked. Decl unique to batch2. Distinct core.

Verified selectorLift def L254-264 and selectorLift_unitary L267-281. selectorLift DEF is shared with block_encoding be-004 (assembly description) but the per-lift UNITARITY LEMMA core (selectorLift_unitary) is unique to batch2 (grep). be-004 uses the def only as a building block of the full composition, not as this standalone proof. new_distinct, accept.

Controlled-permutation (SELECT) bijection+unitarity core: F(coeff,(s,x))=(coeff,(s,p_s(x))) with two-sided inverse using (p_s)^{-1} at SAME s; permutation matrix -> unitary. Verified controlledSystemEquiv L315-327 (left_inv/right_inv by simp) + selectLift_unitary L340-349 via equivPermutationMatrix_unitary. Same-selector-for-inverse essentiality correct. Permutation-matrix composition (contravariant) core: P(second)*P(first)=P(first.trans second); left-mult selects inverse-image row, single surviving summand, order reversal forced by column-vector left action. Verified equivPermutationMatrix_mul_apply L167-187 and equivPermutationMatrix_mul L206-223. Decls unique to batch2. Distinct core (composition law), not the per-permutation unitarity of be-110.

Verified prepareAmplitudeSelectUnprepare def L352-367 and _unitary L370-399. The composition OBJECT appears in block_encoding be-004/be-006, but THIS theorem (group-closure unitarity of the whole composite) is unique to batch2 (grep prepareAmplitudeSelectUnprepare_unitary only here); be-004 is a role/concept description, be-006 is the clean-entry projection. new_distinct, accept.
